description: Handle 7 (builds on Handle 6 / old 2.6, voice-72840084; carries Gripper 21): Viewed edge-on (looking along the gripper's edge, the finger's thickness direction), the handle is still too tall. Make the handle about the same height as the gripper finger itself, not taller. Measured in Handle 6's CAD (v206 params + exports/parts): handle plate height slide_h = 37 mm (2*slot_wall 3 + 2*strap_slot_width 3.5 + slot_gap 24) vs finger thickness plate = 12 mm, so the handle stands 12.5 mm past each finger face (25 mm taller overall). Target: handle height ~12 mm, matching the finger. The strap slots and stop strip will no longer fit across the height as laid out, so rework them as needed. Keep consistent with Base 3 (voice-3b311f32), which asked the same of its handles and added a handle_over param (slide_h = plate + 2*handle_over, 15 mm there): use that same shared parameter, set so the handle matches the finger height, so Handle 7 and Base handles stay in step. New folder, params.json-first per AGENTS.md; name it Handle 7 in VERSIONS.txt / catalog.

results.identified_issue: Plate height = plate + 2*handle_over (handle_over 0, min lowered to 0 from Base 3's 0.5). Base 3's stop strip connects to the plate because handle_over 1.5 > fit+stop_width; at handle_over 0 the strip (y -7..-6.2) would float free, so gripper.scad adds a step-down of the plate's outer part (w slide_w0..w1, y stop_y[0]..-slide_h/2+neck_over, hook floor to floor, trimmed by the finger profile + fit) whenever stop_y[1] < -slide_h/2+neck_over. Without the profile trim it clashed with the finger near the notches (first try failed handle_seated). Rejected: an asymmetric plate shifted ventrally to make 12 mm overall (breaks handle_over symmetry, leaves the dorsal 1.2 mm of edge bare); dropping the stop by default (loses positive retention). Strap tunnel ported from v303 handle_body without the tail (no Base here); boss/tunnel values = Base 3's (strap_slot_width 2.5, slot_wall 1.5); slot_gap removed. genus.py expects 1 handle hole. check_geometry adds handle_height (mesh y extent = plate/2+handle_over dorsal, -(plate/2+max(handle_over,fit+stop_width)) ventral). Base 3 itself was NOT changed (still handle_over 1.5); a Base 4 should set handle_over 0 to match. Dropped stale compare_v205.png and compare_web_stl.* copied from v206. Pivot 27.2512 confirmed from viewer_right; test_gripper_poses.py passes.
results.summary: Handle 7 is now the finger's height edge-on: a 12 mm plate (Handle 6: 37), with the strap through a tunnel instead of two slots.
results.detailed_description:
New folder v207_generalist_flush_handle, Handle 7 in VERSIONS.txt and the catalog. The plate height is plate + 2 × handle_over, the same param Base 3 uses, set to 0, so it's flush with both finger faces at 12 mm.

Two strap slots no longer fit, so I used Base 3's strap tunnel: a boss on the plate's outer face with a 2.5 mm gap under it that runs from one finger face to the other. I kept the stop strip but narrowed it to 0.8 mm. It sits just past the ventral face, so that edge stands 1 mm past the finger and the handle is 13 mm overall. Set Stop strip depth to 0 in Tune if you want exactly 12 mm, but then only friction holds the handle.

All geometry checks pass, including a new edge-on height check. See previews/compare_v206_edge.png. Nothing has been printed.

summary: Viewed edge-on, the Handle 6 plate is 37 mm tall, standing 12.5 mm past each face of the 12 mm gripper finger. Handle 7 should be about 12 mm tall, with the strap slots and stop strip reworked to fit, using Base 3's shared handle_over parameter.
